'''Title'''
Luke Skywalker, Lieutenant Colonel
'''Lore'''
Hero of the Battle of Yavin. Over these three years, he gained experience as a soldier of the Alliance, and his current rank is lieutenant colonel. At the Battle of Hoth, he served as the leader of Echo Base's flight squadron.
'''Game text'''
May deploy only on Hoth, but may move anywhere afterward. Adds 3 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Rogue 1, adds 2 to maneuver. Immune to attrition < 3. All other Rogue Squadron pilots and gunners at the same Hoth location have forfeit +1.
The Japanese title and lore use 中佐, a rank term translated as lieutenant colonel or, in naval usage, commander; the English printing uses Commander. The Japanese game text explicitly says "if piloting Rogue 1"; the English face says "On Rogue 1". Both printed faces give the +3 power bonus to a starship he pilots. The Japanese lore describes three years of military experience and his current rank, rather than the English sentence about promotion in his third year. The final Japanese sentence uses 位置 (location), whereas the original English face specifies a "site".[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. The Players Committee generated the website card list from its Holotable card data, so this wording is that data's transcription of the card; the Players Committee published it on its own website, so it is a version. Icons written out in words, straight single quotes and credit lines in the list are not changes; the text here draws the icons as the printed slips do. The list shows no slip image. * '''PC-E2''' ([[Princess Leia (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB2-L-princessleia-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013Players Committee card image folder (Virtual2-Light/large/), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034559/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.: “May deploy or move as a ‘react’ to same site as an Imperial. Adds one battle destiny if with Han or Vader. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Leia Of Alderaan, Reflection, or matching blaster on Leia. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date, and what was uploaded last counts as the last version). It prints the same slip number as the release-sheet slip (97). * '''PC-E3''' ([[Princess Leia (V) (Virtual Block 2) (Errata 3)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 13)[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=13 Internet Archive], slip [[:File:VL-history-1220-97-front-master.png]]: “May deploy or move as a ‘react’ to same site as an Imperial. Adds one battle destiny if with Han or Vader. During your deploy phase, may ▼ one Leia Of Alderaan, Reflection, or matching blaster on Leia. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' it prints the original release-sheet words again, word for word (the same words as the PC card image, PC-E2). The Master List slip prints no slip number. Immune to attrition < 4.” '''What changed:''' the Remaster rewrote the slip in the Committee's later wording (full text above; icons written out in words here).
